Ava (Content): Quick draft ready — two hero directions + benchmark blurb. Need design + legal + routing checks.

Ava (Content): Hero A: 'Up to 3x lower latency on long-context requests.'
Hero B: 'Lower inference cost while keeping predictable SLAs.'
Benchmark line: 'In our internal benchmarks, Redwood observed up to 3x lower median generation latency on long-context workloads.'

Jules (Growth): Both play. Proposal: A/B test hero + CTA.

Priya (Demand): Routing: 'Request demo' -> SDR queue; 'See benchmarks' -> benchmarks drip; 'Join waitlist' -> nurture. Will confirm HS list names.

Noah (Design): Comps done. Link: https://figma.com/file/launch-hero. Will swap hero assets after copy lock.

Sam (Product): Rosa, legal review needed on the "3x" phrasing — is 'in our internal benchmarks' sufficient?

Rosa (Legal): That works. Suggest adding small-copy qualifier in the benchmarks section: 'Results vary by model and configuration.' Approve with that note.

Liam (Ops): Ops notes — limit immediate demo bookings to NA/EMEA; APAC -> waitlist. Add 60s rate-limit on form.

publish-bot: Created card ML-321: 'Hero copy + legal + routing' assigned to Ava (Content).

Ava (Content): Thanks — I'll add Rosa's line to the body, lock copy, and hand off to creative. Leaving thread open for any last-minute changes. :thumbsup:
